 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's see the meaning of some other words:

 
• **Investigate -** to observe or study by close examination and systematic inquiry
